extracted text: The paper examines A356 aluminum alloy in as-cast and T6 conditions. The T6 heat treatment involves solution treatment at 540°C for 4 hours followed by artificial aging at 165°C for 5 hours. The high strength of the A356 alloy is mainly derived from the precipitation hardening of fine Mg2Si phases, which is dependent on heat treatment conditions. The mechanical properties are also affected by shrinkage, eutectic Si particles, and Fe-rich intermetallic phases.
